scope: Visual pass over all 40 supplied circuit scenes. References below document the landmarks rebuilt in this pass; per-circuit pit references remain in pit-facilities.json.

Spielberg.observations: Perforated weathering-steel plates, lowered head, folded forelegs, braced hind legs, gold horns and a transverse arch. Operator states 17.2 m including the arch.
Spielberg.implementation: Original faceted interpretation at the mapped position; approximately 17.2 m overall. No photographic texture is embedded.

Singapore.observations: Flyer is circular, 150 m diameter, 165 m overall, with 28 capsules. Marina Bay Sands remains across the reservoir from the circuit.
Singapore.implementation: Rebuilt wheel without footprint-based vertical scaling. Retained mapped hotel position and extended land beneath it; reservoir extension follows the frozen OSM shoreline. Removed the former scene-boundary concrete edge across open water.

Baku.observations: Three curved flame-shaped towers around a shared podium; reported heights 182, 165 and 161 m.
Baku.implementation: Replaced the flattened blocks with three separate tapered towers at the mapped landmark site. Extended the approximate terrain beneath the complex.

Suzuka.observations: The operator states approximately 50 m above local ground for the wheel's highest point.
Suzuka.implementation: Replaced the distorted wheel with a circular 45 m rim and hanging gondolas, approximately 49 m overall. Lowered the floating G grandstand 9.37 m until its highest terrain support meets the lowest structure.

limitations: Original stylised geometry, approximate terrain and widened game roads. This pass does not establish survey accuracy, current-event configuration, or exact architectural detail.
